feeds.title: Go Dairy Free
feeds.description: Go Dairy Free is the leading dairy-free website for non-dairy recipes, news, reviews and more. Over 2 million visitors per year for the dairy-free diet.

feeds.title: Simply Whisked
feeds.description: I'm Melissa. We've been a lactose & dairy-free household for three years now, and I'm committed to creating recipes that are just lactose & dairy free.

feeds.title: Milk Free Mom Blog
feeds.description: Milk Free Mom is a collection of Dairy-Free recipes, product reviews, and information for the busy mom catering to dairy allergies.

feeds.title: Vegan Richa
feeds.description: The blog is about flavorful and delicious beans, lentils, veggies, whole grains, nuts, seeds, spices and herbs and a lot more. Vegan Food Blog with Indian Vegan Recipes, Vegetarian, Eggless, Dairy-free. Many Gluten-free, Soy-free.

feeds.title: Lexi's Clean Kitchen
feeds.description: Lexi's Clean Kitchen recipes are gluten-free, mostly dairy-free, paleo-friendly, refined sugar-free, and soy-free. In addition, some are vegan and vegetarian as well.

feeds.title: Thrive
feeds.description: So Delicious Dairy Free has been bringing joy to dairy-free lives for nearly 30 years. We offer an array of delicious dairy-free delights that you can feel good about sipping, biting, pouring, scooping, licking and chugging throughout your day.

feeds.title: Make It Dairy Free Blog
feeds.description: We are Andrew and Larisha, an award-winning photographer and writer team. From recipes to resources to what you can grab to eat at your favorite restaurant, we are sharing all things vegan and plant-based! When possible, we always disclose allergens and talk about what allergies a new food, restaurant, or recipe may include.

feeds.title: The Pretty Bee
feeds.description: Delicious allergy friendly recipes. Covers articles on gluten free, dairy free, and vegan recipes. Mom to two boys with food allergies and sensitivities, author Kelly is passionate about allergy friendly cooking and baking. She believes that you can enjoy amazing, easy recipes even when cooking for multiple food allergies.

feeds.title: That Girl Cooks Healthy
feeds.description: A healthy haven for dairy free and mostly gluten-free recipes with a modern-day Caribbean twist.

feeds.title: The Urben Life
feeds.description: Find hundreds of quick, easy, and healthy meal ideas! All recipes are dairy-free and egg free, with several gluten-free and vegan options. You will also find allergy-friendly travel guides and entertaining tips. I'm Jenna Urben. I started The Urben Life is 2016 with a simple mission, to share dairy free recipes the entire family will enjoy.

feeds.title: Gluten Free Blogger
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Sarah Howells, aka The Gluten Free Blogger. I share gluten-free recipes and advice for living life with coeliac disease. From simple gluten-free bakes to meal ideas, coeliac humor, and more, The Gluten-Free Blogger has everything you need to start living and loving your gluten-free life.

feeds.title: AnnaLaura Brown Blog
feeds.description: AnnaLaura is an essential oils educator, and health enthusiast and has been gluten-free since 2013. She has a passion for helping moms and children live happy and healthy despite diet restrictions and other challenges. She enjoys sharing with you how you can live happy, healthy and still enjoy life without gluten, dairy and chemicals too.

feeds.title: My DairyFree Gluten Free Life
feeds.description: If you like Dairy-Free Gluten-Free or Vegan recipes, healthy giveaways, fun tips and more....follow this blog!

feeds.title: My Life After Dairy
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Annie, I have been living a diary free life after discovering dairy was the root cause of my digestive issues. While giving up cheese was initially difficult, creating a life without dairy is not. On this blog, I share approachable recipes and tips for living a dairy free life.

feeds.title: Moo Free
feeds.description: Moo Free is an ethical family business whose team includes several amazing people with autism. All of their chocolates are dairy free, gluten free, soya free, and certified vegan.

feeds.title: Dairy free kids
feeds.description: Dairy free kids is a blog about food, food allergies and family adventures, written by a Mother of two young boys with milk allergies. The blog is primarily a resource for parents of those with food allergies and contains numerous recipes, allergy advice, and tips, free from product information and stories of our family adventures.

feeds.title: Cassidy's Craveable Creations
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Cassidy and I'm so happy you stopped by! For the well-being of my family, I serve up easy, kid-approved recipes that are gluten free, dairy free, and mostly Paleo.

feeds.title: Sarah Bakes Gluten Free
feeds.description: I'm Sarah, the baker and blogger here at Sarah Bakes Gluten Free. Creating gluten, dairy and egg free recipes, that are approachable and delicious.

feeds.title: Clean Eating Goddess
feeds.description: Exploring gluten free, dairy free, refined sugar free and more. Clean Eating Goddess is all about catering to a wide range of dietary needs while remaining wholesome, nutritious and most of all, delicious!

feeds.title: Silvana's Kitchen
feeds.description: Welcome to my gluten-free, dairy-free kitchen, where food tastes even better than the original—no compromises!

feeds.title: I Hate You Milk Blog
feeds.description: Lactose intolerance and diet blog. Where and how to eat to avoid dairy and lactose.

feeds.title: Free From Favourites
feeds.description: A magical site with lots of gluten and dairy free recipes!

feeds.title: Hope For Healing
feeds.description: All of my recipes are gluten-free, dairy-free, soy-free, refined sugar-free. I'm also a Holistic Health Counselor, with my training from the Institute of Integrative Nutrition in New York City, class of 2009.

feeds.title: Dairy Free Baby and Me
feeds.description: Blogging to spread awareness and knowledge regarding Cow's Milk Protein Allergy and other allergy-related topics!

feeds.title: Dairy Free Daisy
feeds.description: Dairy free reviews and recipes for a dairy free lifestyle.

feeds.title: Dairy Free 'Tried and True'
feeds.description: I am a lucky wife and mother of four. My oldest son was severely allergic to dairy for about 7 years. Even though he does tolerate dairy in the baked forms, I'm still always looking for great dairy free recipes to share because I know there are some readers out there that appreciate this blog!

feeds.title: No Meat, No Wheat, No Dairy
feeds.description: Gluten free, dairy free recipes for vegetarians!

feeds.title: The Stay At Home Cook
feeds.description: I write a blog about Gluten Free and Dairy Free recipes that are safe for my GF/DF husband, and still delicious for our daughter and me!

feeds.title: And Love it Too!
feeds.description: We specialize in making Gluten Free, Dairy Free-living simply delicious to do!

feeds.title: Simply Whole Foods
feeds.description: Hi I'm Hollie! I share step-by-step recipes and tons of healthy eating inspiration. My recipes are dairy free, gluten free and paleo friendly that are perfectly suited for those with allergies and intolerances. I hope you enjoy!

feeds.title: Dairy Free Gina
feeds.description: The best in dairy-free, vegan, gluten-free eating and living with recipes, product and restaurant reviews, cooking tips, and tricks.

feeds.title: Angela's Kitchen
feeds.description: Cooking gluten and dairy free... because everyone deserves a cookie!

feeds.title: Daiya Foods Blog
feeds.description: Deliciously Dairy-Free Cheeses, Meals & More. You'll also find news, information, stories, and recipes from Daiya Foods. Daiya Foods is a Canada-based dairy-alternative food company founded by Andre Kroecher & Greg Blake.

feeds.title: Gluten Free & Dairy Free at WDW
feeds.description: Bringing you delicious gluten free and dairy free reviews and tips from the Walt Disney World Resort!

feeds.title: The Gluten & Dairy-Free Review Blog
feeds.description: Gluten-free and dairy-free blog reviewing restaurants and products, as well as sharing tips about living with dietary restrictions.

feeds.title: A Balanced Belly Blog
feeds.description: I blog everything gut from IBD (which I have) to coeliac disease. I share tons of gluten free, dairy free and low FODMAP recipes and tips for living a balanced life.

feeds.title: Gluten Free & Dairy Free at WDW
feeds.description: Your Daily Dose of Special Diets Disney Dining News!

feeds.title: From Jessica's Kitchen
feeds.description: From Jessica's Kitchen is a food blog with gluten free, dairy free, soy free recipes. Many also egg free.
